title.en: If it rains, the ground is wet

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「若下雨，则地湿」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “if it rains, then the ground is wet” on every row.

t.zh: <level-ref to="table"></level-ref>填过这句话的真值表。证明器里还没有 → 这个门。
t.en: You filled in this sentence’s truth table in <level-ref to="table"></level-ref>. The prover has no → gate yet.

hint.zh: 它在哪些行为真？这些行有什么共同点？
hint.en: On which rows is it true? What do those rows have in common?

hint.zh: 没下雨的两行，加上地湿的两行。
hint.en: The two rows without rain, and the two where the ground is wet.
